# Security

## Supported versions

Only the latest GitHub Release is supported.

## Reporting a security issue

Do not post account tokens, credentials, private Discord data or other secrets in a public issue.

If the issue can be described without sensitive data, open a GitHub issue with minimal reproduction steps. If sensitive material is required, contact the repository owner privately through GitHub before sharing it.

## Release integrity

Official release ZIP files are produced by GitHub Actions from a version tag and published with a SHA-256 checksum. The PowerShell installer verifies that checksum before replacing an existing installation.
